Foodland supports The Academy Stage; EDO and Adelaide University support The Planet Talks.

'WOMADelaide is managed by Arts Projects Australia and WOMAD Ltd'; the WOMADelaide Foundation is a registered charity. History page: Foundation established 2004 as 'the non-profit body that now presents the festival'.
Partners page directs partnership enquiries to Paola Niscioli, Manager, Philanthropy and Development, paola@womadelaide.com.au, +61 8 8271 1488.
